# Building a controller

Three ways to build one. All run the same firmware and the same web UI.

| | [Carrier board](carrier-board.md) | [DIY build](diy-build.md) | [XIAO ESP32-S3](xiao-esp32s3.md) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best for** | A tidy, permanent install | Trying it out cheaply | A small Wi-Fi-only unit |
| **Controller** | WT32-ETH01 | WT32-ETH01 | Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 |
| **Radio** | Ra-02 | CC1101 or Ra-02 | CC1101 |
| **Network** | Ethernet, Wi-Fi | Ethernet, Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi |
| **Assembly** | Plug-in modules, printed case | Hand wiring | Hand wiring |
| **Status** | Tested | Tested | Builds, not yet tested on hardware |

**After building:** [flash the firmware](flashing.md), then follow the
[show setup guide](../guides/show-setup.md).

**Optional extras:** an [external amplifier](amplifier.md) for more range, and a
[printed case](../../hardware/case/README.md) for the carrier board.
